Here's the plan for Springfield Fall 2026 swim lessons for Max and Mia. Registration opens Tuesday, September 15, 2026 at 7:00 a.m. through https://rec.example.org/springfield/fall-2026. Because you're a Springfield resident, your postal code gets the residents-first date, which is that same day. The general public opens 7 days later. Max fits the published age band. Mia is just outside it, close enough that you should check she fits before you commit.

I'll send you a week-ahead note 7 days before, a checklist 3 days before, a reminder the evening before, and a last nudge 15 minutes before it opens. I never register for you. You still click the final button yourself.

If you pick a course, send me its page link and the morning text will carry it.
